failure.title: Performance corpus was layered over demo queue data
failure.note: The second fresh-owned performance smoke retained its 52-row queue validation failure, reserved-prefix and environment cardinalities, redacted service logs, teardown transcript, and empty container, volume, and network inventories. It proved the API returned the two demo queued programmes plus all 50 performance-owned queued programmes before measurement began.
failure.diagnosis: Fresh performance execution applied the normal seven-client demo seed before inserting the standard 50-client corpus. Prefix-scoped corpus checks still reported 50 queued programmes, but the global queue contained two additional demo programmes and therefore violated exact ownership. The bounded warm-up diagnostic serialized the large body before its validation reason, obscuring the decisive 52-row error in the retained message.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
